description: For a sole trader: HMRC's flat rates for working from home and business miles against the business share of the real costs, and which claims more for each. Use for 'should I claim the flat rate for working from home?' or 'what can I claim for my business miles?'.

businessMiles.description: Business miles a year. Defaults to 0.

homeBusinessPct.description: The share of those costs used for the business, as a percentage. Defaults to 0.

homeCosts.description: The home's running costs a year - heating, electricity, council tax, rent or mortgage interest, water - in pounds. Defaults to 0.

homeHours.description: Hours a month worked from home. Defaults to 0.

homeMonths.description: Months of the year worked from home, 0 to 12. Defaults to 12.

totalMiles.description: All miles a year, business and private. Defaults to the business miles.

vehicle.description: car (cars and vans) or motorcycle. Defaults to car.

vehicleCosts.description: The vehicle's running costs a year - fuel, insurance, repairs, servicing, road tax - in pounds. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_home_and_mileage
title: Working from home and mileage
